FAQ

Do you see the names I check?

No. The checks run from your phone and the names are never sent to us, to analytics or to advertisers.

Does "Nothing found" mean a name is free?

Not always. It means no public page was found. Confirm on the site before relying on it.

How do I delete my data?

Delete a name in the app, or use Settings > Clear all my data. There is no account to delete.

How do I stop usage and crash data or personalised ads?

Turn off Settings > Share usage and crash data, and use Settings > Ads privacy options. Pro removes ads.
